mapper.sql: token, user_pk, issued_at, expires_at, last_seen_at, revoked
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_ui_auth_session (token, user_pk, issued_at, expires_at, last_seen_at, revoked) VALUES (#{s.token}, #{s.userPk}, #{s.issuedAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.expiresAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.lastSeenAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.revoked})
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_ui_auth_session SET user_pk = #{s.userPk}, issued_at = #{s.issuedAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, expires_at = #{s.expiresAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, last_seen_at = #{s.lastSeenAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, revoked = #{s.revoked} WHERE token = #{s.token}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tc_ui_auth_session WHERE token = #{token} AND revoked = false AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
